items.hint: Play every main mission through the credits. The checklist itself only appears after the story, but progress made before then already counts.
items.name: Story completion

items.hint: Black-on-pink map icons and purple side icons. Deliveries for Moses and Randy, Tyrone labs, meditations, Cal's fishing and Strangers & Freaks all count — there are a few hundred in the game, so this comes naturally.
items.name: Optional tasks completed

items.hint: Yellow map icons. Loot every key valuable at each of the 39 sites. They respawn after a while, so a forgotten valuable is not missable — just slow.
items.name: Gang operations cleared

items.hint: Unlock in Chapter 3 after Credit Check. Small banks need the cash drawer and the safe; large banks add a vault.
items.name: Bank jobs fully completed

items.hint: Unlock in Chapter 3. Threaten the teller, take the counter cash, then loot the backroom safe and escape the cops.
items.name: Payday loan jobs

items.hint: Pawn shops from Chapter 2, jewelry stores from Chapter 3. Smash the display case AND loot the backroom safe, or the robbery may not count.
items.name: Smash 'N' Grabs

items.hint: Aim a gun at the clerk in convenience, fast-food and liquor stores and loot the register. Fifty different stores, ninety-one on the map.
items.name: Stick-ups

items.hint: Stolen goods, mostly from gang operations and Cocaine Flamingos. Sell them to any fence — this comes naturally with the robberies.
items.name: Narcotics fenced

items.hint: From jewelry stores after Chapter 3. Smash the cases, loot the safe in the backroom, then sell it all to a fence.
items.name: Jewelry fenced

items.hint: From banks and payday loans, after the Dye Pack Jammer unlocks in Chapter 3. One large bank can pay $205,000 in a single hit.
items.name: Marked bills fenced

items.hint: At the eight large banks, after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is. Follow a security van, slip in while the vault is open, and expect a four-star wanted level on the way out.
items.name: Bank vaults robbed

items.hint: Deliver cars to Moses from Chapter 2, later to any Pay 'n' Spray. Randy's wish-list cars pay the most, around $35,000 each in perfect condition.
items.name: Vehicles fenced

items.hint: Kenton's treasure-diving questline, marked from Chapter 1. Dive the shipwrecks he marks and bring the treasures back. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 but reappears between Chapters 2 and 3.
items.name: Kenton sets completed

items.hint: 480 cards across 18 sets; find every card in 15 sets. Some cards have duplicates in several places. Track under Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards.
items.name: Collectible card sets

items.hint: Scan landmarks, sculptures and curiosities with the phone while on foot — a popup tells you when one is near. Track under Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations.
items.name: WAiNK locations scanned

items.hint: Sunken shipwrecks, part of Kenton's questline — you need all seven of his sets for this one. Use the metal detector on the ocean floor.
items.name: Underwater discoveries

items.hint: Twenty-seven magazines plus seven book swaps. Only unique ones count, so duplicates do not help. Track under Progress, Collections, Exploration.
items.name: Magazines, books & comics

items.hint: 100% needs fifteen of eighteen, but the Positive Mental Attitude trophy needs all eighteen — do every spot. With Jason and Lucia together a spot counts double.
items.name: Meditation spots

items.hint: Pink flamingos hidden across Leonida. They also drop narcotics you can fence.
items.name: Cocaine Flamingos destroyed

items.hint: Finish both unique playlists; the Progress menu shows which ones you still need.
items.name: Unique playlists completed

items.hint: Styles discovered across Leonida — clothes, hair and looks picked up while playing.
items.name: Discovered styles

items.hint: Blue race icons on the map. Win thirty of the forty unique races.
items.name: Unique races won

items.hint: Gold medals on race challenges. Ten of thirteen is enough, so skip your three worst.
items.name: Race challenge gold medals

items.hint: Eighteen at Griffin, twenty-four at Rodgers Ranch. Every gold is required, and it is also The Shootist trophy.
items.name: Shooting-range golds

items.hint: Play all four arcade video games.
items.name: Video games played

items.hint: Beat five of the seven pool opponents around Leonida.
items.name: Pool opponents defeated

items.hint: Play a round at two of the three mini-golf locations.
items.name: Mini golf locations played

items.hint: Score at ninety of the one hundred hoops scattered around Leonida.
items.name: Basketball hoops

items.hint: All forty-two drone races, each a timed trial. It is also the groundwork for the Top Fun trophy.
items.name: Drone time trials

items.hint: Any three hundred of 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps. The Cunning Stunts trophy needs only 250.
items.name: Stunts completed

items.hint: Any seventy of the eighty challenges — skip the ten hardest. Track them under Progress.
items.name: Challenges completed

items.hint: Bret's hunting questline: fifteen target decks, all required. Hunting also helps with the animals, so keep the binoculars handy.
items.name: Bret's target decks

items.hint: Scan traffic with WAiNK as it drives past. Boats and aircraft count. Whip It Good unlocks at one hundred vehicles.
items.name: Base vehicles scanned

items.hint: Fifty-three guns, nine melee, four explosives — find any fifty of the sixty-six standard-issue weapons.
items.name: Standard issue weapons found

items.hint: Study animals through the binoculars. No hunting is needed for this one — just look at them.
items.name: Animals studied

note: The checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion only after the story, but everything you do before the credits already counts. Nothing on it is missable — every requirement can still be done in free roam. Counts match PowerPyx's 100% checklist (18 Nov 2026): 12 Story & Tasks, 20 Exploration & Activities, 3 Discovery.
title: A Long Road — 100% completion checklist
